name: FFS_ACTIVITY_TMPL_LOG
description: Used to store modification history for shift/mass/repeating activities.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the log record.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the corresponding action.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of this repeating/mass/shift activity log.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the user who created this activity template.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Time when the activity was created.

columns.name: PARENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Reference to an previous activity template log record.

columns.name: MASTER_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to an initial template record.

columns.name: TEAM_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Activity Team holder resource reference. Used for teamwork activities.

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Reference to shift which activity template log belongs.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reference to Activity template log Work Type List.

columns.name: WORK_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity template log work zone reference . It is a read-only field that is automatically assigned to an activity, based on the company setting 'work zone key' and the activity properties.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Activity template log duration in minutes. Fills with actual duration after activity start.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_ID
columns.description: Reference to time slot during which the activity template log is completed. The time slot also indicates the service window for the activity. This time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_START
columns.description: Activity template log Service window start time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_END
columns.description: Activity template log Service window end time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the activity template log in the origin system. The value can be empty.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NUMBER
columns.description: Activity template log account number of the customer. This field is used by integrations as a placeholder for the external identifier of the Account ID in the application. This parameter has no business significance in Oracle Field Service and can be left empty. Maximum field length is 40.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Activity template log name of the customer. Maximum field length is 420.Encrypted.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
columns.description: Activity template log street address of the customer. This field is used for geocoding and must contain a valid address. Maximum field length is 240. Encrypted.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: Activity template log city of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Activity template log ZIP code of the customer where the activity is scheduled.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Activity template log state of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PHONE
columns.description: Activity template log regular (land) phone number of the customer. . Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL
columns.description: Activity template log email address of the customer. Maximum field length is 320.Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CELL
columns.description: Activity template log cell phone number of the customer. Encrypted.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: Activity template log language. Reference to Language.Lid.

columns.name: REMINDER_TIME
columns.description: Number of minutes before the activity template log start time the customer must be notified of the activity.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity template log Time Zone. Reference to Time_Zone.Zid.

columns.name: TRAVEL_AREA_ID
columns.description: Reference to Travel Area to which actvity template log activity work zone is assigned.

columns.name: TRAVEL_KEY
columns.description: Activity template log travel key. Fills automatically based on Travel key field set on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: DURATION_KEY
columns.description: Activity template log duration key. Fills automatically based on Duration key field set on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Activity template log coordinates found staues: 'Is Found', 'Not_Found'.

columns.name: COORD_ACCURACY
columns.description: Activity template log accuracy Level Of Geocoding Coordinates Not Valid - -1 Undefined - 0 Country - 1 State - 2 County - 3 City - 4 Zip - 5 Route - 6 Street - 7 Intersection - 8 Address - 9.

columns.name: COORD_X
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity template log.

columns.name: COORD_Y
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity template log.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Bitmask. Set of options defining a behaviour of this activity.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date this activity takes effect from.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last date until which this activity takes place. Optional.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: Activity template repeating/mass activity recurrence.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Bitmask. Defines days of week this activity takes place.

columns.name: RECUR_EVERY
columns.description: Time between each recurrence of the assignment. Depending on the value selected for 'recurrence', the value of the parameter indicates the time between recurrence in days or weeks.

columns.name: SLA_START
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window starts. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity template log is currently assigned.

columns.name: SLA_END
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window ends. The time is displayed in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity template log is currently assigned.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines active features for this activity template log. This value is copied from a selected activity type on Create/Update actions.

columns.name: POINTS
columns.description: Number of Points that represent efforts required to perform this activity template log.

columns.name: TIME_OF_BOOKING
columns.description: Time when the customer booked the activity template log. The time is displayed in the time zone of the customer.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: COORD_VIEWPORT_RADIUS
columns.description: Radius of activity location viewport returned by geoprovider in meters.
